header: Send somebody our way and you both get a month written off
lead: € 39 for you and € 39 for the shop you sent, credited against the next invoice as soon as their first till is actually selling.
note: The conditions are on the programme page. There is a ceiling of twelve credits a year, which nobody has reached yet.

steps.title: You send the link
steps.text: It comes out of your own account with your name on it. We never write to anybody off our own bat.

steps.title: They get going
steps.text: Trial, setup, first till on the counter. How long that takes is entirely up to them.

steps.title: Both sides get the credit
steps.text: On the next invoice, with nothing to claim. Anybody still inside their own trial gets it when their first invoice comes.
